stage4_pilot2_audit.root_cause: Prompt directive in stage4/src/simulator.py line 172 ('Write a concise Python function priority(item, remaining_capacity) that returns a float priority score to minimize leftover space') anchored the LLM into emitting strictly decreasing monotonic transformations of (remaining_capacity - item). Because online bin selection uses argmax over open bins, any strictly decreasing transformation f(rem - item) induces the exact same bin ranking as Best-Fit.

redundancy_mechanisms: When local_search_op == 'none', pivot_rule ('first_improvement' vs 'best_improvement') is dead state (60 redundant configs).
When priority_rule produces no exact ties on continuous/wide-range processing times, tie_breaker variants collapse to identical initial job orders.
Different configuration hashes do NOT imply different algorithms unless verified by behavioral trace fingerprinting.

verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.finding: Test & Generalization Holdout Leakage during search evolution: evaluate_candidate() unconditionally executed 'train', 'test', and 'generalization' splits on every candidate evaluation and exposed test_score/generalization_score on live Candidate objects.
verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.remediation: Added include_holdout: bool = False guard in BaseEvaluator.evaluate_candidate() and implemented cryptographic SplitFirewall in north_bluestar/problem.py.

verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.finding: Silent Baseline Impersonation: when a candidate evict_score() raised an exception (e.g. ZeroDivisionError), simulate_cache() caught it and silently substituted score = -float(meta['recency']) (canonical LRU), crediting broken candidates with LRU's 64.9% hit rate.
verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.remediation: Replaced silent LRU fallback with explicit RuntimeError propagation and NaN/Inf rejection so crashing policies are marked invalid.

verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.finding: Silent AST Fallback Masquerading as LLM Discovery: when llm_provider='openai' had no valid client or timed out, generate_candidate() silently fell back to _generate_with_ast() while logging LLM run configurations.
verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.remediation: Enforced fail-closed RuntimeError when an explicit external LLM provider is configured without credentials.

verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.finding: Broken Multi-Parent Recombination & Markov-1 Generational Amnesia: Arm C combine_parents selected two parent IDs (valid_prior[:2]) but only injected best_prior['code_body'] into the prompt, and overwrote prior_gen_eval_results each generation so earlier elites were forgotten.
verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.remediation: Patched stage3/src/search_engine.py to maintain cumulative elite archives across all generations and inject all selected parent code blocks during recombination.

verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.finding: Unkillable Timeout Threads & Penalty-Objective Conflation: ThreadPoolExecutor.shutdown(wait=False) leaves timed-out Python loops running forever in background threads; Stage 2 PFSP originally assigned numeric penalty 1e9 to invalid permutations, inverting evolutionary selection.
verified_legacy_defects_and_fixes.remediation: Built ExecutionSupervisor in north_bluestar/execution.py with OS subprocess isolation and SIGKILL termination, and strictly separated boolean feasibility from scalar objective values.

registered_methods.name: Sandboxed Python AST Program Adapter
registered_methods.description: Executes AST-validated Python candidate functions inside a restricted builtin namespace and subprocess worker.

guarantees: Timed-out worker processes are forcibly terminated via OS SIGKILL (`proc.kill()`), preventing runaway CPU starvation.
Input problem instances are deep-copied before execution so in-place mutation cannot corrupt benchmark data.
Python program candidates undergo AST static analysis blocking imports of os/sys/subprocess/socket and dunder introspection.
Every candidate output is validated by an independent host-process verifier before objective scoring.
non_guarantees: Does NOT claim containment against kernel zero-days or arbitrary native code execution without an external container/nsjail/Firecracker microVM boundary.
